note: Independent re-judge after 4ceb0f7416. Section 4.2.2 read in rfc/full/rfc6793.txt: "The NEW BGP speaker MUST also send the AS path information in the AS4_PATH attribute (encoded with four-octet AS numbers), except for the case where all of the AS path information is composed of mappable four-octet AS numbers only." New positive TestRFC6996OldSpeakerReceivesStrippedASPathAndAS4Path asserts the exact AS4_PATH value 0204 0000fde8 0000fbf0 00010000 0000fbf1 ([65000 64496 65536 64497]) toward a two-octet EBGP peer on the real forward path: present, four-octet encoded, and carrying the same path information as the AS_PATH with the real AS in place of AS_TRANS. Break attribute/as4.go:434 AS4PathFor returning nil removes the attribute and was observed red. The except clause stays covered by the unchanged negatives TestOriginatedUpdateOmitsAS4PathWhenEveryASIsMappable and TestRFC6793TranscodeOmitsAS4PathWhenAllMappable (no AS4_PATH when every AS is mappable); unchanged positives in message and wireu assert AS4_PATH with the real four-octet AS toward an OLD speaker. Whole sentence covered, both polarities genuine.
